claim:
Text: "Trash Can Plastered With 'Ballot Box' Sign In Philadelphia Was Intended To Get People To Toss Their Ballots In The Trash."
Claim date: October 27, 2020
before_justification: The fact-check finds that the trash cans labeled "BALLOT BOX" in Philadelphia were placed by the Union League Legacy Foundation on October 23, 2020, as an advertisement for a voting rights exhibit, [as reported by The Inquirer](https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/election-2020-ballot-box-trash-can-ad-philadelphia-union-league-foundation-20201023.html). The signs were removed within hours by authorities to prevent confusion with actual ballot boxes, and there is no evidence any official ballots were discarded or that the intent was malicious.
after_justification: Photos and videos confirm the presence of a trash can labeled "Ballot Box" in Philadelphia in October 2020, but official reports from authorities, documented cases of voters mistakenly discarding ballots, and evidence of intent or responsible parties are absent from the record. The available documentation establishes only the physical object, not its purpose or any consequences, leading to the verdict that the specific claim about intent is unsupported.
